rules: Nobody acts against an equal or higher effective role: bans, role changes and moderation of a global_mod need admin, of an admin need owner.
The owner's account, streams, keys, content and admin role are protected from everyone but the owner, whatever capability the actor holds.
Staff are never swept up by IP or alt cascades.
Staff capabilities are carried only by Network user tokens. A service, app or mod token never holds one, and they are never delegated (ADR-003 amendment 2026-09-24).
A service may vouch for its user as staff (X-OV-Staff) only while it holds the owning service's moderate capability, and the vouch is logged (ADR-022).
Roles change only in Network. A product that changes a role locally must push it to Network, or the next token undoes it.
Every staff action is reported to Network's moderation audit log as a <service>.moderation.action event (ADR-022).
